entry.title: Keeping the learning real: an integrated approach to academic integrity in the age of AI
entry.summary:
I-Wonkhe kunye nenkonzo yovavanyo i-Studiosity baphonononge imigaqo-nkqubo yeeyunivesithi zaseBritane, baze babambe iingxoxo neenkokeli zeziko kunye nabafundi ngoSeptemba 2026 ngengqibelelo yezemfundo ngexesha le-AI evelisayo. Ingxelo, epapashwe ngomhla we-4 kuOktobha 2026, ifumanisa ukuba amaziko ayeka ukugcina umthetho ngokusebenzisa izixhobo zokufumanisa ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI, aze agxile kwindlela yovavanyo eguqulweyo, ukufundiswa ngolwazi lwe-AI, kunye neendlela ezingohlwayo ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukufunda kwenzeke ngokwenyani. Ichaphazela ukuba inkqubo yengqibelelo yezemfundo isengena kuhambelana, ayikabi nokuthenjwa ngabafundi, abangathandabuzekiyo ukuba amaziko aya kuwakholelwa amazwi abo ngendlela abawasebenzise ngayo i-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufundisa, uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo, oku kuyingxelo enabileyo yakutsha nje ebonisa indlela inkqubo yemfundo ephakamileyo enkulu eguqula ngayo uvavanyo kunokuba izame ukufumanisa ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI, ize inikeze isakhelo esisebenzayo sesikhokelo kubaphathiswa nabafundi.

Wonkhe / Studiosity · UK higher education policy platform report, based on institutional policy review and sector roundtables

entry.title: Digital solidification: learning analytics, the panopticon, and data coloniality in South African higher education
entry.summary:
USingh, we-University of Johannesburg, uthi uhlalutyo lokufunda lunesakhiwo esifana ne-digital panopticon, esiguqula iingxaki zexeshana, ezinje ngokucima kombane okanye ukunqaba kwedata yomnxeba, zibe zingxelo ezingatshintshiyo ezibeka abafundi esimweni esimbi ngonaphakade, ngaphakathi kohlaka lobukoloniyali bedata. Iphepha alithatheli ingozi uhlalutyo lokufunda njengoluyingozi ngokwalo, kodwa lilumkisa ukuba iiflegi ezingaphindwa ziphononongwe okanye zihlaziywe zenza nzulu imeko yoMzantsi Afrika engalingani ngokwendalo nangolwimi. Liphakamisa uhlaka olujoliswe kubulungisa boluntu, olusekelwe kwimanyano yedata, uphononongo olubandakanya abafundi kwi-algorithm, kunye nokutolikwa kweeflegi ngokweemeko njengesikhuthazo sokuxhasa kunokuba zibe isohlwayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Lo ngumbono ophandwe ziingcali ngokuthe ngqo waseMzantsi Afrika ogxeka izixhobo zohlalutyo oluqikelelayo eziphambili kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI noHlalutyo oluqikelelayo lwempumelelo yabafundi, unika intsika yeqela ye-AI ethembekileyo, imigaqo yokuziphatha kunye nolingano iinkqubo zokhuseleko ezisekelwe phambi kokucebisa ngeenkqubo zesilumkiso kwangethuba.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Helpful or harmful? Generative AI dependence, self-reported critical thinking disposition, and self-perceived employability among business students
entry.summary:
Oo-Shojaei kunye noogxa babo baphonononge abafundi bemfundo yesiqalo bokuphatha ushishino abangama-412 kwiiyunivesithi ezintathu e-Oman, malunga nokusetyenziswa kwe-AI evelisayo, ukuxhomekeka kuyo, isimo sengqondo yokucinga ngobunzulu kunye nokuqesheka okuziva ngakho. Ukusetyenziswa okukhulu kwe-AI kudibaniswe nokuqesheka okuziva ngakho okuphakamileyo, kodwa ukuxhomekeka ngaphezulu kwe-AI kudibaniswe nokucinga ngobunzulu okubuthathaka, kuze kubuthathe amandla ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kokusetyenziswa kwe-AI nokuqesheka, kuse kwinqanaba apho kungabi nabungakanani kokuxhomekeka okuphezulu. Ababhali bagqiba ngokuthi inzuzo ixhomekeke kukusetyenziswa kwe-AI ngokucingisisa nangokuqinisekisa, kungenjalo kubukhulu bokusetyenziswa, nangona uyilo lwemibuzo ezichaza ngokwazo nolwexesha elinye luthintela amabango ngokubangelana.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Oku kuthetha kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga kunye nokuqesheka, kubonisa ukuba ukuxhomekeka ngaphandle kokuqwalasela kwi-AI kunganomngcipheko wokonakalisa loo masakhono acingwa ngabaqeshi, isilumkiso esibalulekileyo kwinkqubo zokuqesheka kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Assessment practices resistant to inappropriate AI use in Open Distance eLearning: insights from Zimbabwe Open University
entry.summary:
Oo-Magwa noZongozzi, be-University of South Africa, badlulisele udliwano-ndlebe nootitshala, abafundi kunye nomxhasi-manejala wokuqinisekisa umgangatho e-Zimbabwe Open University, kwikhampasi yaseMasvingo, ngokuphathelele kuhlobo luphi lovavanyo oluxhathisa ukusetyenziswa okungafanelekileyo kwe-AI evelisayo. Bafumanise ukuba uvavanyo olusekwe kumsebenzi wokwenza, olucingisisayo, olumlomo kunye nolujongwe ngononophelo kwiinqanaba zokufundisa, lubonwa njengolunzima ngakumbi ukuqhathwa ngendlela engenyanisekileyo ngokusebenzisa i-AI, nangona oku kuphakamisa inkxalabo ngomthwalo womsebenzi wootitshala kunye nobungakanani bamakilasi. Ababhali balumkisa ukuba iziphumo ezivela ekhampasini enye yommandla azinakwenza isigwebo ngeziko liphela okanye ngemfundo yokuqhutywa kwaphulo nokugqithiselwa kude ngokubanzi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Oku kunika imbono yoMzantsi weHlabathi kunye nemfundo yokuqhutywa kwaphulo nokugqithiselwa kude ngokwakhiwa kwakhona kovavanyo ukulwa ukusetyenziswa kakubi kwe-AI evelisayo, kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, nto ebalulekileyo ngokuthe ngqo kwinkqubo zokuqhutywa kwaphulo nokugqithiselwa kude kuyo yonke lo mmandla.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Automated software scoring of senior school certificate examination mathematical items in economics using a contextual similarity model
entry.summary:
Oo-Olaoye, Owolabi noOlaoye baphonononge indlela yekhompyutha yokuvavanya ngokuzenzekelayo imibuzo yemathematika eyandisiweyo kwi-Economics yamabanga aphezulu kwintshona-ntshona yeNigeria, bathabatha isampulu yabafundi aba-1,008 kubantu abalinganiselwa kuma-275,000. Amanqaku eesoftware avumelana ngokusondeleyo nalawo abalisi abalishumi elinamibini abaqeqeshelwe lo msebenzi, ngomlinganiselo ophezulu wokuhambelana phakathi kweembalo ka-0.863. Ababhali bachaza ukuba uvavanyo lwaqukwa yimibuzo emibini kuphela, nokuba umbalisi ngamnye wamaka amaphepha angama-84 kuphela, ngoko kusafuneka uvavanyo olongezelelweyo phambi kokuba isetyenziswe ngokubanzi kuviwo olunje ngeWAEC, NECO neNABTEB.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Lo ngumsebenzi obonakalayo, odibanisa i-STEM, wokusetyenziswa kohlalutyo lovavanyo oluvavanywe ngesondo lesizwe kuNtshona Afrika, luthetha kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD malunga ne-AI kunye noHlalutyo kwi-STEM kunye nenkqubo zemfundo ezinkulu.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Six publishers agree to feed 20 million research papers to AI agents, in a pay-per-use deal
entry.summary:
Abashicileli bemfundo abathandathu, phakathi kwabo iSage, iBMJ Group kunye ne-Institute of Physics, bavumelene ukuvumela inkampani entsha yaseSweden ekuthiwa iRedpine ukuba ifake amaphepha angaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-20 ehlolwe ziingcali kwii-arhente ze-AI ngethuba lokwenzeka, ngokutsho kwe-Times Higher Education nge-6 Okthobha 2026. Isivumelwano sokuhlawula ngokusetyenziswa sibhatala abashicileli kunye nababhali nje ukuba inkqubo ye-AI isebenzisa umsebenzi wabo, kugubungela amajenali ezonyango, ezesayensi yobomi nezesayensi yemvelo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelele kwi-AI enembopheleleko, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, esi sivumelwano sivavanyo lokuqala sokuba lushicilelo lwezifundo lunakuthini ukugcina i-AI isekelwe kuphando oluqinisekisiweyo kunokuba kube ngumqikelelo, ngelixa kusafunwa ukuba ngubani ohlawulwayo xa yinjini, ingengumfundi, ecaphula umsebenzi.

Times Higher Education · Established press (Times Higher Education)

entry.title: Mystery-shopper study finds university enquiry replies 'costing enrolments', as ChatGPT outperforms
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lokuthenga ngokufihlakeleyo kwiidyunivesithi ezingama-33 zaseBritane kunye nezingama-30 zaseOstreliya, olwenziwe ngenkampani yongcebiso iEdified kunye nenkampani yoqeqesho iUniQuest, olwacaphulwa ngueTimes Higher Education nge-1 Okthobha 2026, lufumanise ukuba ipesenti ezingama-37 kuphela kuzibuzo ezimalunga namakhulu asixhenxe zabafundi ekunqwenelekayo ukuba babhalise zafumana impendulo eyakhuthazayo ukuba baqhubeke bezibandakanya. Ipesenti ezilishumi elinesihlanu zezibuzo azaphendulwa konke konke, kwaza impendulo zeChatGPT zagqwesa ngokukhawuleza, ngokupheleleyo nangokunqwenelekayo ngaphezu kwezeedyunivesithi ngokwazo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelele kuhlalutyo kunye nedata yeenkqubo zemfundo kunye nokuthatha izigqibo, olu phononongo luyisikhumbuzo esibukhali sokuba amaziko aqokelela idata ngabafaki-zicelo kufuneka asebenzise loo data, ekubeni phantse ababini kwabathathu babafundi ekunqwenelekayo kwisampulu bashiyekile bengaqinisekisiwe yimpendulo yomntu apho i-AI ecelwe ngendlela elungileyo ingayinikezile ngcono.

Times Higher Education · Established press (Times Higher Education), citing a study by Edified and UniQuest

entry.title: How computer-science students actually use large language models varies sharply by task, study finds
entry.summary:
Iphepha lophando elifakwe kwi-arXiv ngomhla woku-1 Okthobha 2026 lihlalutye indlela abafundi bezidanga abangama-211 abasebenzisa ngayo iimodeli zolwimi ezinkulu kwiimodyuli ezisixhenxe zekhosi yokusombulula iingxaki kwisayensi yekhompyuta. Abafundi basebenzisa izixhobo kakhulu kwimisebenzi ye-algorithms nophuhliso lwewebhu, baza basebenzisa kancinci kubunjineli beesoftware, ngokubanzi bezijonga njengabancedisi ekufuneka bakhutshwe iphutha kunokuba bazithembe ngokupheleleyo, bevavanya imiphumela ngokuvavanya kwimisebenzi elandelekayo nangokukhangela kwiwebhu kwimisebenzi ongaqondakaliyo isiphelo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelele kwi-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufunyaniswa kokuba amaqhelo okuvavanya ayatshintsha ngokwomsebenzi owenzelweyo, ingekuphela ngomfundi, kubonisa ngokucacileyo indlela ingqibelelo yezemfundo noyilo lovavanyo olufanele lutshintshe umsebenzi ngomsebenzi.

arXiv · Working paper (arXiv preprint)

entry.title: Cross-border virtual teamwork lifts intercultural readiness in data-analytics and machine-learning courses, study finds
entry.summary:
Iphepha lophando elifakwe kwi-arXiv ngomhla woku-1 Okthobha 2026 ngu-Sehrish Basir Nizamani kunye noogxa bakhe, lichaza inkqubo yokutshintshiselana esetyenziswa kwi-intanethi eyilelwe ngendlela elulandelekayo, ehlanganise abafundi bezidanga zekhompyuta baseMelika nabasePakistan kuprojekthi yezigaba ezintandathu ezingahambelani ngexesha, yohlalutyo lwedata nokufunda komatshini. Abafundi babika amava athuthuzelayo rhoqo, kwaza abaphandi bafumanisa ukuba unxibelelwano phakathi kweenkcubeko, ngaphezu kobuchule bobugcisa, yiyo eyaphembelela indlela abazizwa belungele ngayo ukusebenza ehlabathini liphela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwintsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelele kwi-AI nohlalutyo kwizifundo zeSTEM nemfundo yootitshala, olu phononongo lunika umzekelo ovavanyiweyo wokusebenza ngeqela phesheya kwemida, ngexesha elingahambelaniyo, okufunekayo kubafundi bekhompyuta boMzantsi weHlabathi ukwakha isakhono sobugcisa kunye nesakhono senkcubeko ngaphandle kokushiya ikhaya.

arXiv (accepted, IEEE Frontiers in Education 2026) · Working paper (arXiv preprint, accepted IEEE FIE 2026)

entry.title: Copenhagen university appoints an anthropologist, not a computer scientist, to lead its AI strategy
entry.summary:
IYunivesithi yaseCopenhagen iqokele isazi se-anthropology Morten Axel Pedersen njengosekela-mongameli wakuqala we-AI, ikhetha umphengululi wendlela abantu ngokwenene abaziphatha ngayo kunesosayensi yekhompyutha ukuba akhokele icebo lemali eyi-110 yezigidi zedola yaseDenmark eliquka iofisi ye-AI, iqela lomsebenzi, iilebhu kunye nomncedisi we-AI evelisayo owenzelwe eyunivesithi. UPedersen, owakhe wayalathisa i-Centre for Social Data Science yeyunivesithi, ucwangcisa ukuhlola zonke izifundo kweyunivesithi ngaphakathi konyaka ukuze agqibe indlela i-AI efanele isetyenziselwe kuzo, kwaye uchaza isikhundla sakhe seminyaka mithathu njengesakhelo sethutyana esiya kuchithwa nje ukuba iinkalo zemfundo ziba nemigaqo yazo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufundisa, uvavanyo kunye nengqibelelo yezemfundo, ukhetho lweCopenhagen luthetha ukuba indlela abafundi nabasebenzi ngokwenene abasebenzisa ngayo i-AI, kungekhona nje into umgaqo-nkqubo oyithethayo, sisiqalo esifanelekileyo sotshintsho lokufundisa nolovavanyo; i-Wits AHEAD iyibona njengobungqina bokuba ulawulo lwe-AI kwigumbi lokufundela ngumbuzo wabantu kangangoko ingumbuzo wobuchwepheshe.

Times Higher Education (Seher Asaf) · Established press profile

entry.title: UK research network to redo grant review after AI triage rejected half of proposals
entry.summary:
I-CRANE, uthungelwano lophando lokhuseleko lwe-cyber e-UK olubambelwe e-University of Oxford kwaye luxhaswa yi-UK Research and Innovation, luvumile ukuphinda lwenze uphononongo lwaso lwesicelo semali ngemva kokuba inkqubo ye-AI triage yala cishe isiqingatha seezicelo ezili-179 eyazifumeneyo ngaphambi kokuba nabani na umphononongi womntu azibone. Uthungelwano luthi lusebenzise iinkqubo ezivaliweyo, ezikhuselekileyo, kungekhona iinkonzo ze-AI zoluntu, kwaye akukho datha yesicelo eyakusetyenziselwa ukuqeqesha imodeli, kananjalo lumisile ngokwexeshana iindululo zemali esele zinikezelwe ngelixa sonke isicelo esikhutshelweyo ngaphandle siphinda sihlolwa liphaneli laso.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, lo mcimbi ulumkiso lokuba ukwenza isango lokuxhaswa kophando lizenzekele, ngaphandle kokutyhila nendlela yokubhena, kungavala umsebenzi osemthethweni ngaphambi kokuba nabani na umntu awufunde; i-Wits AHEAD ibonisa uphinda-uphononongo, kungekhona impazamo yodwa, njengomgangatho ekufuneka naziphi na iziko ezisebenzisa i-AI kuphononongo olubalulekileyo zibanjwe ngawo.

Times Higher Education (Frances Jones) · Established press investigation

entry.title: Tshwane University of Technology dialogue presses South Africa to move from AI strategy to implementation
entry.summary:
I-Institute for the Future of Work yeTshwane University of Technology ibambe i-Future of Work Dialogue yayo yesihlanu yonyaka ePitoli, idibanisa urhulumente, abaphengululi bezifundo kunye nezishishino phantsi komxholo wokuqhubela phambili ikamva eliqinileyo le-Afrika ngokusebenzisa i-AI. Umlawuli ophambili Tseliso Mohlomi uthi uMzantsi Afrika kufuneka udlule kwisicwangciso nengxoxo yokusebenzisa i-AI, ekhankanya ukhuseleko lwe-cyber, i-cloud computing, ukufunda i-AI kunye nobunjineli bedatha njengoobalulekileyo ekufuneka kwenziwe kwangoko. Iingxoxo zahlaziya kwakhona isindululo, esingazalisekiswanga kususela kwintlanganiso yonyaka ophelileyo, se-National AI Implementation Council eya kudibanisa urhulumente, iiyunivesithi kunye nezishishino ekuzuzeni iziphumo ezibonakalayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, i-AI, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, isibhambathiso sengxoxo zokusebenzisa kunokuqhubeka ngomgaqo-nkqubo sijongana ngqo noxhala lwe-Wits AHEAD ukuba amaxwebhu omgaqo-nkqubo wodwa awadali imisebenzi; ibhodi elidibanisa olunjengoko lundululwayo lilona lwakhiwo ekuya kufaniswa kulo uqeqesho lweyunivesithi needingo zoobalulekileyo abatshintsha ngokukhawuleza.

iAfrica.com (Thebe Mabanga, Inside Education) · Established press report on a university-hosted policy dialogue

entry.title: Liberia advances a national education data system to inform real-time decisions
entry.summary:
ISebe lezemFundo laseLiberia liqukumbele iingxoxo kazwelonke ngomgaqo-nkqubo omtsha we-Education Management Information System (EMIS), oxhaswa yi-African Union ngendlela yesiko layo, i-Pan-African Institute for Education and Development. Isekela loMphathiswa Thomas Momo Parker uthe idatha ethembekileyo nefikelelayo ngexesha iyafuneka ukucwangcisa, ukubhajeti nokuthatha isigqibo, ngoxa isebe liqalisa kwakhona i-Annual School Census kunye neencwadana zokugcina iirekhodi zesikolo ngokomthetho. Iingxoxo, ezibanjelwe eMonrovia kunye ne-European Union, i-UNESCO, i-Plan International Liberia kunye ne-UNICEF, zafumanisa izithuba kulawulo lwedatha, kwizixhobo, kubuchule bobugcisa nakuxhaso lwemali.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 5, uhlalutyo kunye nedatha yeenkqubo zemfundo nokuthathwa kwezigqibo, inyathelo laseLiberia libonisa ukuba uhlaka lukazwelonke lwedatha, kungekhona nje izixhobo ze-AI, lusisiseko esidingwa nayiphi inkqubo kuMzantsi weHlabathi ngaphambi kokuba izixhobo zoqikelelo okanye amadashbhodi athenjwe; i-Wits AHEAD ilandela imisebenzi enjalo njengemfuneko ephambi koko uhlalutyo lwaphaya kwenye indawo.

African Newspage (Ministry of Education, Republic of Liberia) · National government announcement

entry.title: A college president on harnessing AI in education without cutting corners
entry.summary:
Umongameli we-Colby College, uDavid Greene, uxelela i-ABC News indlela le kholeji yaseMelika ye-liberal arts esebenzisa ngayo ubukrelekrele bokwenziwa ekufundiseni nasekufundeni ngendlela athi ihambelana nemigaqo yokuziphatha kwaye engathabathi zindlela zimfutshane. Yingxelo emfutshane, evela ngqo kumntu oyibonileyo, yobunkokeli bamaziko kwi-AI.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ibonisa inkokeli yeyunivesithi ejonga i-AI njengento ekufuneka ibunjwe ngabom kunokuba ilawulwe ngokubekwa esweni kuphela, isimo i-Wits AHEAD esixhasayo kwiiyunivesithi zase-Afrika.

ABC News · ABC News (US national broadcaster)

entry.title: What should a university be in the age of AI? SABC News on the first Times Higher Education summit in Africa
entry.summary:
Phambi kwe-Times Higher Education World Academic Summit, ebanjwe yi-University of Cape Town ukususela nge-29 Septemba ukuya kwi-1 Okthobha, eyokuqala ukubanjelwa emhlabeni wase-Afrika, i-SABC News ibuza ukuba iyunivesithi kufuneka ibe njani njengoko i-AI itshintsha indlela abantu abasebenza ngayo, abafunda ngayo nabavelisa ngayo ulwazi. ISekela leNqununu kwiZophando noBudlelwane bamaZwe ngamaZwe e-UCT, uNjingalwazi Thokozani Majozi, uxoxa ngomxholo wale ngqungquthela, "Knowledge, justice and futures: Universities in the age of intelligence", kunye nendima yeeyunivesithi engaphaya kokuvelisa abaphumelele izidanga.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, izakhono zabaphumelele izidanga nokuguquka kwabo besiya emsebenzini, umbuzo wale ngqungquthela wokuba iiyunivesithi zinoxanduva lwantoni kubaphumelele izidanga nakuluntu njengoko i-AI iguqula umsebenzi ngumbuzo weqela ngokwalo, ngoku obuzwa kwiqonga laseMzantsi Afrika.

SABC News · SABC News (public broadcaster)

entry.title: African scholarship is building a decolonial agenda for AI in university classrooms, systematic review finds
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olucwangcisiweyo kwijenali ye-Trends in Higher Education luhlalutya izifundo ezingama-25 ukususela ngo-2010 ukuya ku-2025 malunga nokupheliswa kobukoloniyali (decoloniality), ubukrelekrele bokwenziwa kunye namagumbi okufundela eyunivesithi kwimfundo ephakamileyo yase-Afrika. Ukupapashwa kukhawuleze emva ko-2020 kujikeleze imixholo emithathu, ukungabikho kobulungisa kulwazi kunye nekharityhulam, ubukoloniyali be-algorithm kunye nokuxhatshazwa kwedatha, kunye notshintsho ekufundiseni olufunwa yi-AI evelisayo, uphando lugxile kakhulu eMzantsi Afrika, kukho nomsebenzi osakhulayo welizwekazi lase-Afrika liphela kwi-AI yeelwimi zase-Afrika. Ababhali bafumanisa ukuba kukho inkqubo yophando lwe-AI yokupheliswa kobukoloniyali ehambelanayo esakhiwayo, kodwa ukuza kuthi ga ngoku bubuncinane ubungqina obusekelwe kuphando lwasebaleni.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, luchaza imibuzo yokuba lulwazi lukabani neelwimi zikabani i-AI ezizisa kumagumbi okufundela ase-Afrika, lubonise nokuba isiseko sobungqina sisebhityile kangakanani, isikhewu uphando kwi-Wits School of Education olunokunceda ukusivala.

Trends in Higher Education (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed systematic review

entry.title: AI emerges as a distinct part of the student academic experience in a survey of 2,403 Bolivian undergraduates
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwabafundi bezidanga zokuqala abangama-2,403 kwiyunivesithi yabucala e-Bolivia, olupapashwe kwijenali ye-Education Sciences, luqinisekisa ukuthembeka koluhlu lwemibuzo olunezinto ezingama-31 malunga namava ezemfundo, kwaye lufumanisa ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI ekufundeni kwabo, njengoko kuxelwa ngabafundi, kulicandelo elahlukileyo ecaleni kokuzibandakanya, ukucinga ngokuhlalutya, umgangatho wokufundisa nokuzinikela. Ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI okuxelweyo kwakunonxulumano oluhle nokuzibandakanya kwezemfundo kunye nezakhono zonxibelelwano, zokuziphatha nezokucinga ngokuhlalutya; ababhali bagxininisa ukuba esi sixhobo silinganisa iimbono, hayi iziphumo zokufunda.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, isixhobo esiqinisekisiweyo saseMzantsi weHlabathi esijonga ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI njengenxalenye yendlela abafundi abafumana ngayo amava eyunivesithi sisixhobo esiluncedo iqela elinokusilungiselela uphando lwezimvo zabafundi eMzantsi Afrika, kunye nesilumkiso sababhali sokuba silinganisa iimbono, hayi ukufunda.

Education Sciences (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Oxford let OpenAI train AI models on Bodleian Library texts, the Guardian reports
entry.summary:
Amaxwebhu angaphakathi afunyenwe liphephandaba The Guardian abonisa ukuba iYunivesithi yaseOxford ivumele i-OpenAI ukuguqula iimbalo zembali ze-Bodleian Library yayo zibe nkqubo yeedijithali, kubandakanya iiskena ezingama-125,000 zeethisisi zobugqirha zenkulungwane yeshumi elinethoba kunye neyamashumi amabini, kunye neengoma zasesitratweni ezili-10,000 zexesha lase-Tudor, ukunceda ukuqeqeshwa kweemodeli zayo ze-AI. Ubambiswano lwaseOxford nee-OpenAI, olwaziswa ngo-2025, lwaziswa njengeprojekti yokwandisa ukufikelela kwiimbalo ezinqabileyo; akwaziswanga ukuba ezi skena ziya kusetyenziselwa ulwazi lokuqeqesha lwee-OpenAI. Amanqaku entlanganiso angaphakathi abonisa ukuba amalungu ekomiti yolawulo abonakalise inkxalabo ngomngcipheko kwimfaneleko kunye nendleko yamandla ye-AI, ngelixa iOxford ithi loo mbalo mncinci ngomlinganiselo, awusekho phantsi kwamalungelo omlinganiso, kwaye uya kupapashwa kwi-intanethi kwiinyanga ezizayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: Kwi-Ntsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, lo mcimbi ulumkiso kuyunivesithi nokuba iyiyiphi, nokuba kusemazantsi eHlabathi okanye eOxford, evumela inkampani ye-AI ukuphatha iimbalo okanye ulwazi lwayo: ngaphandle kwesaziso esicacileyo soluntu malunga nendlela imbalo iya kusetyenziswa ngayo, iprojekti yokufikelela yokwenyani inokubonakala, emva koko, ngathi sisivumelwano esifihlakeleyo sokunikezela ulwazi, nokuyiyona ntsasa yokusungululeka u-Wits AHEAD ebongoza amaziko ukuba avale ngaphambi kokutyikitya.

The Guardian (Ethan Penny and Dan Milmo) · Established press investigation

entry.title: University of Ghana approves an AI policy and a compulsory digital literacy course for every student
entry.summary:
IBhunga leYunivesithi yaseGhana lamkele umgaqo-nkqubo we-AI oya kusetyenziswa kwiyunivesithi iphela, owenziwe emva kwenjongo yokuphononongo yangaphakathi efumene izikhewu kuqeqesho, ukufikelela okulinganiselweyo kwizixhobo ze-AI, kunye neenkxalabo malunga nokuchaneka, ingqibelelo yezemfundo kunye nemigaqo yokuziphatha. Ekubikeni oku kumsitho wokuphothula iziqu eAccra, apho abafundi abali-1,884 baphothule, isekela-rector, uNjingalwazi Nana Aba Appiah Amfo, wathi iyunivesithi iya kuphinda ifune kumfundi ngamnye, ukususela unyaka wezifundo olandelayo, ukuthatha ikhosi entsha enyanzelekileyo yolwazi lwedijithali kunye ne-AI esetyenzisiweyo, ihamba kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo owahlukeneyo wokufundisa nokufunda.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, indlela iyunivesithi karhulumente ehambela kwimixholo yesikhokelo ukusa kwikhosi enyanzelekileyo yolwazi lwe-AI kumphumelele ngamnye, isekelwe kubungqina bayo yakwayena ngeendawo abafundi nabasebenzi abasokola kuzo, luhlobo lwempendulo elihlelwe kwaye elisebenzisa iyunivesithi iphela elikhangelwayo nguWits AHEAD ngaphesheya kwemveliso, kunye nokungabi migaqo-nkqubo ihleli kuphela kwiphepha.

University of Ghana (policy document); Ghanaian Times · University policy document

entry.title: OECD finds generative AI use nearly universal in higher education but only one in five institutions has a formal policy
entry.summary:
Ingxelo ye-OECD, ethi Policies supporting responsible and systematic GenAI adoption in higher education, epapashwe kuluhlu lwe-OECD Education Spotlights, ifumanisa ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI evelisayo phakathi kwabafundi beyunivesithi kuphantse kwaba yinto yabantu bonke, kunyuka ukusuka kuma-66 ekhulu abafundi baseBritane ngo-2024 ukuya kuma-95 ekhulu ngo-2026, kunyuka nama-86 ekhulu abafundi kuphononongo olwenziwe emazweni ali-16. Noko ke, ngama-19 ekhulu kuphela amaziko emfundo ephakamileyo emhlabeni jikelele abanomgaqo-nkqubo osesikweni we-AI evelisayo ngo-2025, nangona ama-42 ekhulu ngaphezulu ayilungiselela, kwaye ngama-17 ekhulu kuphela abasebenzi bezemfundo emhlabeni jikelele ababalwa njengabasebenzisi abaphambili okanye iingcali.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo, umsantsa oqikelelwa i-OECD, phakathi kokusetyenziswa kwemihla ngemihla okuphantse kwaba yemizekelo yabantu bonke kunye nolawulo olusesikweni kuyunivesithi enye kwaye zintlanu, yiyo kanye isantsa u-Wits AHEAD awasekwa ukunceda ukuvala, kunye nomkhumbuzo wokuba ukwamkela izixhobo ze-AI kunye nokulawula kunoxanduva ngumsebenzi omibini owahlukeneyo oninzi lwayunivesithi lingekawuphethi nalinye lwayo.

University World News (Karen MacGregor), reporting an OECD report · Intergovernmental research report, reported by established press

entry.title: African universities urged to collaborate and use AI responsibly, Times Higher Education summit hears
entry.summary:
KwiTimes Higher Education World Academic Summit eKapa, umphathi wophuhliso lwamashishini weinhlangano kummandla waseMzantsi weSahara, uMosebjadi Petje, ubize amayunivesithi aseAfrika ukuba abelane ngeenkqubo zophando nobuchule ukujamelana nemiceli mngeni eqhelekileyo efana notshintsho lwemozulu kunye nentswela-ngqesho yolutsha, kwaye ukwamkela i-AI "ngoxanduva" kunokuyala. Ukwakhuthaze amaziko ukuba asebenzise idatha yawo siqu ukwenza izigqibo zenkqubela, kungekhona kuphela ukubonwa kuluhlu, ethetha kubathunywa abasuka kumayunivesithi angaphaya kwama-55 aseMzantsi weSahara akwiTimes Higher Education World University Rankings.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, isibongozo esivela ngaphakathi kwicandelo lamayunivesithi aseAfrika ngokwalo sokwabelana ngeenkqubo nokusetyenziswa kwe-AI ngoxanduva, kunokuba kulandelwe imimiselo ethathwe kwamanye amazwe, sihambelana ngokuthe ngqo nendlela yentsebenziswano eholwa yiAfrika uWits AHEAD ewusebenzisayo kulawulo lwe-AI kwimfundo ephakamileyo.

Channel Africa (SABC international service) · Established broadcaster

entry.title: US unemployment rate for university graduates falls to 2.5%, lowest of any education group, official data show
entry.summary:
I-United States Bureau of Labor Statistics ixela ukuba izinga lentswela-ngqesho kubantu abane-digri okanye ngaphezulu lehla lisa kuma-2.5% ngoSeptemba 2026, kusuka ku-2.7% ngoAgasti, lihlala lisezantsi kunawo onke amaqela emfundo abawalandelelayo. Ingxelo, i-USDL-26-1549, ikwabonisa ukuba intswela-ngqesho kubasebenzi abangenayo imfundo yeyunivesithi ihlala iphezulu ngamaphesenti ambalwa ngengxowa enye.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, i-AI, ubuchule babaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, idata esisiseko yase-US ebonisa umsantsa wentswela-ngqesho uphinda wenziwa banzi ngabo banedigri, ikhumbuza ukuba, nangona i-AI itshintsha ukuqeshwa kokuqala emhlabeni wonke, idigri yeyunivesithi isahlinzeka ngenzuzo enyanisekileyo kumsebenzi, nto leyo uphando lwe-Wits AHEAD ngokuqesheka oluvavanya kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employment Situation News Release (September 2026) · National statistics office

entry.title: UCT vice-chancellor says all students will be trained to use AI, not banned from it
entry.summary:
Ethetha kwiTimes Higher Education World Academic Summit eKapa, isekela-rector yeYunivesithi yaseKapa, uNjingalwazi Mosa Moshabela, uthe iyunivesithi iwele kuthintela ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI eveliswayo ukusa kuqeqeshweni kwabo bonke abafundi ukuba bayisebenzise ngoxanduva, kumanqanaba awohlukeneyo. I-UCT iyekile ukuxhomekeka kwiinqheliso zokuchonga i-AI ukubeka iliso kumsebenzi wabafundi, kwaye ngoku iyijonga i-AI, ngamazwi akhe, njenge "iqabane kwiprojekti yokufundisa nokufunda". Iyunivesithi ikwasebenza ukwenza izixhobo ze-AI zifikelele ngaphandle kwekhampasi, kuba izixhobo zorhwebo zisasele zibiza kakhulu kuluntu oluninzi kweli lizwekazi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI eveliswayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, utshintsho olu lusuka kubeka iliso kusetyenziswa kwe-AI ukusa kuqeqeshweni kwabo bonke abafundi ngumqondiso ocacileyo kakhulu wokuba iyunivesithi enkulu yoMzantsi weHlabathi ngoku ijonga ulwazi lwe-AI njengobuchule obusisiseko kwabaphumelele izidanga, kungenjalo ingxaki yesiyalo, isicwangciso umsebenzi wePolisi yeWits AHEAD kuvavanyo nokunyaniseka osilandela ngokusondeleyo.

University of Cape Town News (story by Niémah Davids) · University announcement

entry.title: AI governance becomes higher education's top technology priority for the first time, EDUCAUSE survey finds
entry.summary:
I-EDUCAUSE, umbutho wobuchwepheshe bemfundo ephakamileyo waseMelika naseKhanada, uxela ukuba uphando lwawo lwe-2027 Top 10 IT Issues, olwenziwe kubaphathiswa bobuchwepheshe abali-882, lubeke umbuzo wokuba i-AI ingenisa ixabiso lokwenyani phi kwindawo yokuqala okokuqala, lugqithisa ukhuseleko lwenethiwekhi. Uyilo lweenzo ze-AI zokuqulunqa ngendlela enoxanduva nokwakha indlela yokulawula idatha eyomeleleyo nazo zibandakanyeke phakathi kweziyishumi eziphambili, ezivele kwinani elikhulu kunazo zonke labaphenduli kolu phando.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, esi siphumo sibonisa ukuba ulawulo lwe-AI selibe ngumbuzo ophambili kubuchwepheshe kwimfundo ephakamileyo kuMntla kwiHlabathi nakuMzantsi weHlabathi, utshintsho lo msebenzi wePolisi yeWits AHEAD ewuphendula ngqo.

EDUCAUSE 2027 Top 10 IT Issues (via Campus Technology) · Higher education technology association survey

entry.title: University of Pretoria vice-chancellor says graduates need AI fluency and power skills, not just a degree, to find work
entry.summary:
Kwinqaku lembono elipapashwe kwi-Daily Maverick, isekela-rhuluneli yeYunivesithi yasePitoli, uNjingalwazi Francis Petersen, uthi ukungaphangeli kwabaphumelele izidanga eMzantsi Afrika kuqhubeka kunye nokunqongophala kobuchule kubaqeshi ngenxa yokuba iiyunivesithi zisafundisa abafundi umsebenzi omnye wokuqala endaweni yotshintsho lwemisebenzi ngobomi babo bonke. Uthi abaqeshi ngoku balindele abaphumelele izidanga abakwaziyo ukusebenzisa i-AI ngamandla, kunye nonxibelelwano, intsebenziswano kunye nokucinga okunzulu, kwaye ubiza inkxaso-mali yamathuba okuqeqesha emsebenzini, ukufunda okudibeneyo nomsebenzi kunye nenkxaso kushishino kuzo zonke izifundo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka kunye notshintsho olunobulungisa, isekela-rhuluneli yaseMzantsi Afrika ekhankanya ubuchule be-AI njengobuchule obuphambili bokuqesheka, kunye nobuchule bokuziphatha abaqeshi ababufuna kakade, iyomeleza ingxoxo yomsebenzi weWits AHEAD odibanisa uhlalutyo, ikharityhulam kunye neziphumo zabaphumelele izidanga.

Daily Maverick (Professor Francis Petersen, Vice-Chancellor, University of Pretoria) · University vice-chancellor opinion article, established press

entry.title: Bangladeshi university students show moderate knowledge but mixed practice on AI-assisted plagiarism, study finds
entry.summary:
Uphononongo olubandakanya abafundi abali-386 eziyunivesithi zikarhulumente nezabucala e-Bangladesh, olupapashwe kwijenali ye-AI and Ethics, lufumanisa ulwazi olumiphakathi kunye nokwenza okungaqhelani ngokuphathelele i-AI-giarism, into enokusebenzisa izixhobo ze-AI evelisayo ukwenza umsebenzi owethulwa ngokungathi ngumfundi ongqo, nangona iimpawu ngobunyani kwezemfundo zinqabile ngokubanzi ukuba zilungile. Iimpawu zahluke ngokubalulekileyo ngohlobo lweyunivesithi, imeko yokuhlala, amava okupapasha nesifundo, kwaye abafundi abafundiselwe ukubhala kwezoqeqesho bazibika zizenzo ezingcono.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, uvavanyo kunye nobunyani, isifumaniso sokuba isimo esihle asiqinisekisi ukwenza okulungileyo sikhumbuza ukuba ulwazi nge-AI, kungekhona umgaqo-nkqubo wedwa, yiyo ekhusela ubunyani bovavanyo, umbuzo onoxanduva olufanayo kubalingani be-Wits AHEAD baseMzantsi weHlabathi.

AI and Ethics (Noakhali Science and Technology University) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Lisbon university combines early-warning alerts with compulsory AI literacy to protect first-year students, study finds
entry.summary:
Uphononongo lwemeko yesikhokelo sonke se-Iscte, iZiko leYunivesithi yaseLisbon, olupapashwe kwijenali ye-Education Sciences, luchaza iminyaka esithoba yokudibanisa inkqubo yesilumkiso kwangethuba esekelwe kwimithetho esikhombisa abafundi bonyaka wokuqala abasesichengeni kunye nekhosi yolwazi olubuthe nge-AI eyimfuneko kwikampasi enye kwaye ikhethwa kwenye. Ababhali bachaza ukuba isichengiso kwezemfundo sigxininisa emaqeleni abonakalayo, nokuba isiseko esiqhelekileyo solwazi nge-AI sinokufezekiswa, kodwa inkxaso ifikelela kwiinani elincinci kuphela labo bakhonjiweyo, kunye nokuba iimodeli zokuqikelela eziqeqeshelwe kwiqela elinye azisebenzi kakuhle kwiqela elilandelayo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 2, uhlalutyo oluqikelelayo lwempumelelo yabafundi, ukubagcina kunye nesilumkiso kwangethuba, le mbono yenyaniso, yokuba inkxaso kunye nokuqikelela zombini zinemida yokwenyani, zisisilumkiso esiluncedo kuWits AHEAD njengoko silinganisa izixhobo zayo zesilumkiso kwangethuba kunye noovimba ekufuneka ukuba kwenziwe ngabo.

Education Sciences (Iscte - University Institute of Lisbon) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: OECD data show graduate unemployment rising for the first time since its records began
entry.summary:
Ingxelo ye-OECD i-Education at a Glance 2026, eyaphehlelelwa ngomhla wama-29 kuSeptemba 2026, ifumanise ukuba intswela-ngqesho phakathi kwabantu abaneminyaka eyi-25 ukuya kwengama-34 abanesidanga seyunivesithi inyuke ngamanqaku epesenti angama-0.4 kumazwe angamalungu phakathi kuka-2023 no-2025, ngelixa intswela-ngqesho phakathi kwabo banemfundo yesekondari ephakamileyo kuphela yehle ngamanqaku epesenti angama-0.2. Oku kunciphise umsantsa oqhelekileyo, kwaye kokokuqala ukuguquka okunjalo kubonakala ukususela oko olu ludweliso lwamanani lwaqala ngo-2000. UMzantsi Korea ubonisa le meko ngokucacileyo: ama-71.1% abantu bawo abaneminyaka eyi-25 ukuya kwengama-34 banesiqinisekiso semfundo ephakamileyo, ngaphezulu kakhulu komyinge we-OECD wama-47.5%, kodwa izinga lawo lokuqeshwa kwabaphumelele izidanga elingama-80.1% lingaphantsi komyinge we-OECD wama-86%.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka notshintsho olunobulungisa, olu lolona phawu lucacileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku kuwo onke amazwe e-OECD lokuba inzuzo yesidanga kwimarike yemisebenzi iyancipha kanye ngeli xesha i-AI iguqula imisebenzi yabaqalayo, umkhwa ekufuneka i-Wits AHEAD iwulandele ithelekisa nedatha yaseMzantsi Afrika ngokwawo malunga nokuba baya phi na abaphumelele izidanga.

OECD, Education at a Glance 2026 (via UPI) · Intergovernmental body data, reported by an international wire service

entry.title: Côte d'Ivoire launches UNESCO-backed AI training for 3,000 vocational education teachers
entry.summary:
UMphathiswa (Minister Delegate) weMfundo yezoBugcisa noQeqesho lweZakhono zoMsebenzi waseCôte d'Ivoire, uJean-Louis Moulot, uphehlelele inkqubo ngomhla wama-25 kuSeptemba 2026 yokuqeqesha ootitshala bemfundo yezakhono zomsebenzi, abaongameli bezokufundisa nabalawuli abangama-3,000 kwi-AI, ngenkxaso yobugcisa evela kwi-UNESCO. Isigaba sokuqala siqhuba ukusuka ngomhla woku-1 ku-Okthobha ukuya kowama-30 kuDisemba 2026, siqeqesha ootitshala abali-1,000 e-Abidjan kwiziseko ze-AI, ukusetyenziswa kwayo kwezemfundo, iindlela zovavanyo, imigaqo yokuziphatha nokhuseleko lwedatha, phambi kokuba le nkqubo yolingo ihlolwe ukuze yandiswe kwilizwe liphela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 3, i-AI nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nakwimfundo yootitshala, le yinkqubo enqabileyo ekhokelwa ngurhulumente nexhaswa yi-UNESCO eqeqesha abaqeqeshi bootitshala ngokwabo, hayi abafundi babo kuphela, imodeli i-Wits AHEAD enokufunda kuyo kumsebenzi wayo neekholeji zezobugcisa nezakhono zomsebenzi zaseMzantsi Afrika.

TrendsnAfrica · Government programme launch with UNESCO technical support, reported by regional press

entry.title: Ghana commits to train 100,000 TVET facilitators in AI under new UNESCO and Microsoft partnership
entry.summary:
I-Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Service yaseGhana isayine isivumelwano sokuqondana (memorandum of understanding) ne-UNESCO, i-KPMG ne-Microsoft ngomhla wama-30 kuSeptemba 2026 sokuqeqesha ubuncinane abaququzeleli be-TVET abangama-100,000 kwi-AI nakwizakhono zedijithali phantsi kwenkqubo i-AI EmpowerED. Umlawuli-jikelele we-TVET Service, uGqr Eric Kofi Adzroe, uthe olu budlelwane luphawula utshintsho olusingise kwinkqubo engqamene noshishino, eqhutywa yitekhnoloji kwaye egxile kwiziphumo, ngelixa ummeli we-UNESCO kwelo lizwe, uEdmond Moukala, etyikitye isivumelwano egameni lalo mbutho.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka notshintsho olunobulungisa, ukuxhobisa abahlohli bezobugcisa nezakhono zomsebenzi ngezakhono ze-AI kweli nqanaba kunokuguqula indlela isizukulwana sonke samagcisa neengcali zobugcisa zaseAfrika esingena ngayo kwimarike yemisebenzi eguqulwa yi-AI, imodeli i-Wits AHEAD eyibukeleyo ifuna izifundo ezinokusebenza kwicandelo le-TVET laseMzantsi Afrika.

Graphic Online · National press, government partnership announcement

entry.title: US learning platform data shows AI tools trail far behind other classroom technology
entry.summary:
Ingxelo entsha ye-Instructure i-EdTech Top 40, esekelwe kwidatha engachazi magama yabasebenzisi bemfundo ephakamileyo abazizigidi ezili-19.5 beqonga lokufunda i-Canvas phakathi kukaSeptemba 2025 no-Epreli 2026, ifumanise ukuba i-Google Gemini, esona sixhobo se-AI esizimeleyo esamkelwe kakhulu, ifikelele kubasebenzisi abangama-87,788 kuphela kumaziko angama-211, yaye ayikwazanga kungena kwizixhobo ezidityanisiweyo eziyi-100 eziphambili. Izixhobo esele zisaziwa ezifana ne-McGraw Hill, enabasebenzisi abazizigidi ezili-11.3, uvavanyo lweekhosi lwe-Watermark ne-Zoom zahlala zisetyenziswa ngokubanzi ngakumbi. Usekela-mongameli we-Instructure, uRyan Lufkin, uthe iiyunivesithi zityikitya izivumelwano ze-AI zeziko lonke ngaphandle kokuba zibe sele zifake ezi zixhobo kumsebenzi weekhosi wemihla ngemihla.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, umsantsa phakathi kweelayisensi ze-AI zamaziko nokusetyenziswa kwayo okwenyani eklasini sisilumkiso i-Wits AHEAD esilandelayo: ukuthenga ukufikelela kwizixhobo ze-AI akufani nokuzidibanisa nokufundisa novavanyo, kwaye umsebenzi weqela ngokwalo malunga nokwamkelwa ngokusebenzayo uthetha ngqo ngalo msantsa.

Inside Higher Ed · Established press report on industry usage data

entry.title: UNESCO programme trains over 100 rural teachers and principals across China and Southeast Asia in AI and STEM
entry.summary:
I-UNESCO ixele ngomhla wama-30 kuSeptemba 2026 ukuba i-China-Southeast Asia Capacity Development Programme for Teachers and Principals yayo, eyabanjwa eBeijing ukusuka kowe-17 ukuya kowama-23 kuAgasti 2026 phantsi komxholo othi 'STEM and AI: Empowering Rural Teachers for Digital Transformation', ihlanganise abenzi bemigaqo-nkqubo yemfundo, iinkokeli zezikolo, ootitshala neengcali ezingaphezu kwe-100 abavela e-China nakumazwe aseMzantsi-mpuma Asia. Iququzelelwe kunye ne-International Research and Training Centre for Rural Education ye-UNESCO, i-SEAMEO RECSAM, i-UNESCO Chair on Artificial Intelligence in Education eBeijing Normal University kunye ne-OECD, le nkqubo igxile ekusebenziseni i-AI nokufundisa i-STEM ukuze kuqhubele phambili ulingano lwedijithali kwiindawo zasemaphandleni ezingafumani nkonzo yaneleyo. UNjingalwazi Shahbaz Khan, umlawuli we-Regional Office for East Asia ye-UNESCO, ubize 'i-AI egxile ebantwini, enemigaqo yokuziphatha nebandakanya wonke umntu kwimfundo'.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 3, i-AI nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nakwimfundo yootitshala, ukugxininisa kwale nkqubo ukuba itekhnoloji inokuxhasa kodwa ingaze ithathe indawo yootitshala basemaphandleni kunika imodeli i-Wits AHEAD enokuyisebenzisa kumsebenzi wayo wokulungiselela abaqeqeshi bootitshala kwiindawo ezingenazixhobo zaneleyo kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

UNESCO · Intergovernmental body

entry.title: Ethiopia's Education Ministry says AI will support, not replace, teachers as it expands digital learning
entry.summary:
UMphathiswa wezeMfundo wase-Ethiopia, uBerhanu Nega, uthe ngomhla wama-29 kuSeptemba 2026 ootitshala kulo lonke ilizwe baxhaswa ukuba basebenzise i-AI ekulungiseleleni izifundo, ekuphuhliseni umxholo, ekuxhaseni abafundi nakuvavanyo, kunye nokwenziwa kwedijithali kwe-Education and Higher Education Management Information Systems zesebe. UMphathiswa ugxininise ukuba i-AI iziswa ukuze yomeleze amandla ootitshala, hayi ukubathatha indawo, njengenxalenye yomzamo obanzi wokufunda kwi-intanethi, ukufunda okuxubileyo nokufunda ngeziqinisekiso ezincinci (micro credentials), kunye noqhagamshelwano lwedijithali olomeleleyo kwiiyunivesithi nezikolo. Ubize ukuba inkqubo yemfundo idlule ekufundeni ngentloko, iphuhlise abantu abacinga nzulu abakwaziyo 'ukusebenza kunye noomatshini'.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, nakwiNtsika 5, uhlalutyo nedatha kwiinkqubo zemfundo, isebe likazwelonke elizibophelela esidlangalaleni kwi-AI njengenkxaso kootitshala endaweni yokubathatha indawo, kunye nohlaziyo lwedatha kwinqanaba leenkqubo, luhlobo lophawu lomgaqo-nkqubo i-Wits AHEAD elulandelayo kuMzantsi weHlabathi wonke.

allAfrica (Ethiopian News Agency) · National press, government ministry announcement

entry.title: Africa must build its own AI solutions rather than import them, says UN scientific panel member
entry.summary:
UGirmaw Abebe Tadesse, okhokela i-AI for Good Lab ye-Microsoft eKenya nolilungu le-Independent International Scientific Panel on Artificial Intelligence yeZizwe eziManyeneyo, uxelele i-UN News ngexesha le-UN High Level Week eNew York ngomhla wama-25 kuSeptemba 2026 ukuba amazwe aseAfrika kufuneka achonge iingxaki zawo phambi kokwamkela itekhnoloji eyilwe kwezinye iindawo. Uthe abachaphazelekayo, kuquka amaziko emfundo ephakamileyo, oorhulumente, amaqabane ophuhliso neenkampani zetekhnoloji, kufuneka bahlanganise ulwazi lwabo ukuze bakhe izisombululo ezifanele iimeko zalapho endaweni yokuphinda umzamo omnye, kwaye walatha kubantu abaselula baseAfrika njengomthombo wezinto ezintsha esele usebenzisa itekhnoloji kwimingeni yoluntu.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, umcebisi wezenzululwazi we-UN obiza iiyunivesithi ngokucacileyo njengamaqabane abalulekileyo kwi-ajenda ye-AI ekhokelwa ngabantu balapho womeleza isizathu sokugxininisa kwe-Wits AHEAD kuphando nezisombululo ezingabaseAfrika, hayi izakhelo ezingeniswe zivela kwamanye amazwe.

allAfrica (UN News) · UN News Service, intergovernmental body

entry.title: Cape Town hosts first African THE World Academic Summit as Wits and four other South African universities rise in the world rankings
entry.summary:
I-Times Higher Education World Academic Summit ivulwe kwi-University of Cape Town ngomhla wama-30 kuSeptemba 2026, okokuqala ukuba lo msitho ubanjelwe kwilizwekazi laseAfrika, kunye nokuphehlelelwa kwe-THE World University Rankings 2027. Iiyunivesithi ezintlanu zaseMzantsi Afrika ngoku zikwiiyunivesithi ezingama-500 eziphambili ehlabathini, kuquka i-Wits ekwindawo ye-301 ukuya kweye-325, ngelixa i-University of Cape Town inyuke yaya kwindawo ye-147 ekwabelwana ngayo, eyona ndawo yayo intle kwiminyaka esixhenxe. USekela-Ngqonyela we-UCT, uMosa Moshabela, uthe iyunivesithi icime izixhobo zayo zokubona i-AI ukuze igxile ekufundiseni abafundi ukusebenzisa i-AI ngendlela efanelekileyo, ngelixa uMphathiswa weMfundo ePhakamileyo uButi Manamela ephawule ukuba abantu abatsha abathandathu kwabalishumi eMzantsi Afrika abaqeshwanga.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, isigqibo se-UCT sokuyeka ukubona i-AI ukuze kufundiswe ukuyisebenzisa ngendlela efanelekileyo siphawula utshintsho kumgaqo-nkqubo wovavanyo i-Wits AHEAD elulandelayo kulo lonke icandelo, kwaye ukunyuka kumanqanaba kunye nenani lentswela-ngqesho elichazwe nguMphathiswa kugxininisa isizathu sokuba i-AI, uhlalutyo nesakhono sabaphumelele izidanga zibalulekile kuyo yonke iyunivesithi yaseMzantsi Afrika, kuquka i-Wits.

Daily Maverick · Established press

entry.title: Alliance for African Partnership meets in Dar es Salaam and puts AI skills at the centre of regional cooperation

category.term: Africa (Tanzania, hosted by the University of Dar es Salaam)

entry.summary:
I-Alliance for African Partnership, umanyano lweeyunivesithi ezili-12 ezivela kumazwe ali-10 aseAfrika olusekelwe yi-Michigan State University, ibambe intlanganiso yayo yonyaka ka-2026 kwi-University of Dar es Salaam ukusuka kowe-16 ukuya kowama-22 kuSeptemba. USekela-Ngqonyela woPhando uNelson Boniface uxelele abathunywa ukuba iiyunivesithi kufuneka zihlaziye iikharityhulam zazo kwaye ziqeqeshe abahlohli ukuze abaphumelele izidanga bangashiywa ngasemva yi-AI, esongeza ukuba ulwazi lwe-AI ngoku sisakhono esifunwa ngumfundi wonke, hayi zizazinzulu zekhompyutha kuphela.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 4, isakhono sabaphumelele izidanga, ukuqesheka notshintsho olunobulungisa, isibongozo se-Alliance sohlaziyo lwekharityhulam noqeqesho lwabahlohli kumazwe alishumi aseAfrika sivumelana nesizathu se-Wits AHEAD sokufaka ulwazi lwe-AI kuzo zonke izifundo, hayi kwi-STEM kuphela, ukuze abaphumelele izidanga baseAfrika bahlale beqesheka.

allAfrica.com, from the Daily News (Tanzania) · Established African news service

entry.title: Morgan State University wins 10 million dollar federal grant to build a trusted AI research institute
entry.summary:
I-Morgan State University, iyunivesithi yabantu abaNtsundu ngokwembali (historically Black university) eBaltimore, ifumene inkxaso-mali yomanyano lwase-United States engangeedola ezizigidi ezili-10 ukuseka i-Institute for Trusted Autonomous Networks, eyaziwa ngokuba yi-TITAN, ngokwesibhengezo seesenetha zase-US uChris Van Hollen noAngela Alsobrooks ngomhla we-16 kuSeptemba 2026. Le nkxaso-mali yeminyaka emihlanu ixhasa uphando noqeqesho lwezidanga zobugqirha kwi-AI, kukhuseleko lwe-intanethi (cybersecurity) nakukhuseleko oluphuculwe yi-quantum, kwaye injongo yayo kukunceda i-Morgan State ifikelele kwinqanaba eliphezulu leeyunivesithi zophando zaseMelika.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 3, i-AI nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nakwimfundo yootitshala, ukugxila kwe-TITAN ekuqeqesheni abaphandi bezidanga zobugqirha kwiyunivesithi yabantu abaNtsundu ngokwembali kubonisa indlela inkxaso-mali ekujoliswe kuyo yophando lwe-AI enokwandisa ngayo uluhlu lwabo bakhokela uphando lwe-AI, umbuzo i-Wits AHEAD ewulandelayo malunga nolingano kwi-STEM kwihlabathi liphela.

CBS News Baltimore · Established press

entry.title: MIT trains faculty from other universities to teach AI across disciplines
entry.summary:
I-MIT Stephen A. Schwarzman College of Computing iqhube ngokolingo ucweyo lweveki enye oluqeqesha abafundisi abavela kwezinye iikholeji neeyunivesithi ukufundisa i-AI nokufunda koomatshini (machine learning) kwizifundo zabo, besebenzisa izixhobo eziguqulelwe kwikhosi ye-MIT ethi "Modelling with Machine Learning". Ucweyo lokuqala ngoJulayi 2026 luhlanganise izifundiswa ezili-19 ezivela kumaziko asixhenxe, kuquka i-Allen University, i-Babson College, i-Brandeis University kunye ne-University of Massachusetts at Lowell, nabahlohli be-MIT abangaphezu kwesithandathu abafundise iiseshoni ezigubungela ezemali, isayensi yekhompyutha nozinzo.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 3, i-AI nohlalutyo kwi-STEM nakwimfundo yootitshala, le nkqubo yolingo ijongana nesithintelo i-Wits AHEAD nayo ejongene naso: izifundiswa ezingaphandle kwesayensi yekhompyutha zidinga uqeqesho olusebenzayo nolwezandla phambi kokuba zikwazi ukufundisa ulwazi lwe-AI ngokuthembekileyo kwizifundo zazo.

MIT News · University announcement

entry.title: UNESCO survey finds most Latin American and Caribbean universities use AI, but few have a strategy
entry.summary:
I-International Institute for Higher Education in Latin America and the Caribbean (IESALC) ye-UNESCO, isebenzisana ne-United Nations University Institute for the Advanced Study of Sustainability, yenze uphando kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo angama-200 kumazwe ali-19 yaze yapapasha iziphumo zayo ngomhla wesi-8 kuSeptemba 2026 ngexesha le-Digital Learning Week ye-UNESCO. Ifumanise ukuba ama-87% amaziko sele esebenzisa i-AI kwicandelo elinye ubuncinane lomsebenzi wawo, ubukhulu becala ekufundiseni nasekufundeni, kodwa ama-26% kuphela anesicwangciso esisesikweni se-AI. Uninzi lwemizamo ye-AI luqalwa zizifundiswa, ngabaphandi okanye ngabafundi ngabanye, hayi ziinkokeli zamaziko.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 6, i-AI enoxanduva, imigaqo yokuziphatha, ulingano nomgaqo-nkqubo, umsantsa phakathi kokusetyenziswa kwe-AI phantse kuyo yonke indawo nolawulo olusesikweni eLatin America naseCaribbean ubonakalisa ipatheni i-Wits AHEAD eyilandelayo kuMzantsi weHlabathi wonke, apho isenzo semihla ngemihla sihamba phambi komgaqo-nkqubo wamaziko.

UNESCO IESALC and United Nations University · Intergovernmental higher education body report

entry.title: University of Colorado system adopts a living policy for responsible use of AI
entry.summary:
I-Administrative Policy Statement 6012 entsha ye-University of Colorado system, ethi Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence, iqale ukusebenza ngomhla wama-24 kuAgasti 2026 yaze yachazwa kwibhlogi yemigaqo-nkqubo yeyunivesithi ngomhla wama-21 kuSeptemba. Imisela okulindelekileyo kuyo yonke inkqubo malunga nengqibelelo yezemfundo, ukhuseleko lwedatha, ukungafihlisi nokuqinisekisa ukuchaneka komxholo oveliswe yi-AI, kwaye ichazwa ngokucacileyo njengomgaqo-nkqubo ekujongwe ukuba uguquke njengoko kufika izimvo ezivela kubafundi nabasebenzi.

Kutheni kubalulekile kwi-AHEAD: KwiNtsika 1, i-AI evelisayo kwimfundo ephakamileyo, ukufundisa, uvavanyo nengqibelelo, inkqubo enkulu yeyunivesithi kawonkewonke ekhetha ukuphatha imithetho yayo ye-AI njengoxwebhu oluphilayo endaweni yomgaqo-nkqubo ongaguqukiyo ngumzekelo wokuthelekisa ovela kuMntla weHlabathi kwiinketho zolawulo i-Wits AHEAD ezilandelayo kuMzantsi weHlabathi.

University of Colorado · University policy announcement
